description: This file implements the Eos class for handling end-of-stream operations in a WebAudio context within the Rialto server project. It includes constructor, destructor, and execute methods that interact with GStreamer via a wrapper.

classes.name: Eos
classes.description: Handles end-of-stream signaling for WebAudio playback in the Rialto server, utilizing GStreamer wrapper.

methods.name: Eos::Eos
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Eos object with WebAudioPlayerContext and GStreamer wrapper.

methods.name: Eos::~Eos
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of Eos object lifecycle.

methods.name: Eos::execute
methods.description: Executes the end-of-stream command by calling gstAppSrcEndOfStream on the GStreamer source.
